description: Illustrative startup lifecycle template. Declares the expected set of action_ids for a 'complete startup': which steps, in what order, and what counts as complete. This is the intension — what SHOULD be there. A concrete run cites the actual sealed capsule digests it produced separately, as the extension (what IS there); evaluate() in run_example.py computes the diff.
order: strict — declared order is the only valid order; an out-of-order member is a finding
completeness: all 7 members required, each verified — a partial startup is a finding, never a silent gap
